result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall with no obvious layout breakage or missing UI elements. Only minor content/presentation issues were found: a promotional headline that omits its minimum-order condition and a promo code with weak visual emphasis.

issues.description: The promotional banner states "3 free deliveries for you" with code TALLINN3, but also specifies a minimum order of €10, which makes the offer's headline potentially misleading since it does not mention the minimum order requirement prominently.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the headline, e.g. "3 free deliveries over €10", or display the minimum order requirement with more visual emphasis.

issues.description: The promo code text "TALLINN3" uses a different, lighter typographic treatment than the surrounding copy, making the code slightly less prominent and harder to read/copy.
issues.suggestion: Render the promo code in a bolder or higher-contrast style, or place it in a distinct, clearly labeled badge/chip to aid scanning and copying.
